title: NVIDIA Reranker component is nonfunctional without custom logic
body:
### Feature Request

Allow the NVIDIA Reranker component to accept vector store search results as input.

### Motivation

The NVIDIA Reranker component does not work straight out-of-the-box. One must either edit the component to directly accept the search results from a vector database, or edit a vector database component to output a retriever. Retrievers were removed [as output from vector database components in this linked PR](https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/4979). Reverting this change would go against current philosophy about composability; therefore, I will open a PR that allows the NVIDIA Reranker to accept Search Results from Vector Stores as input. This also allows us to change only one file, whereas reverting the change would require editing all vector store components.

Furthermore, the NVIDIA Reranker is marked as legacy but this should not be the case. There is veritable interest from various parties in keeping the Reranker updated and available for RAG applications.

### Your Contribution

[My fork.](https://github.com/brian-ogrady/langflow)

linked_prs.title: feat: make NvidiaRerankComponent work with search_results
linked_prs.body:
This pull request refactors the NvidiaRerankComponent by removing an unused legacy flag, renaming the output from 'search_results' to 'reranked_documents', and eliminating the base_retriever output. Additionally, it updates the document handling to utilize the new Data model, ensuring type safety and consistency. These changes enhance the clarity, maintainability, and functionality of the component.

Fixes #5734 

Thanks @brian-ogrady!

Co-authored-by: @brian-ogrady
